title: Multi-turn tool calling (tool-eval-bench, 88 scenarios): CuteAFD v4.0.0 and the vLLM fork v0.9.2 on K3.25 and K4, CuteAFD on K4-Core-K6
question: Does multi-turn tool calling work, and does its tool-eval-bench outcome differ, between CuteAFD v4.0.0 and tpurtell's vLLM fork v0.9.2 (same K4 checkpoint; on K3.25 each engine runs its own variant, Core-FP8 on CuteAFD and v1 on the vLLM fork)?
engines: tpurtell/cuteafd v4.0.0 (image digest not given in this run's files)
tpurtell vLLM fork v0.9.2 (recipe glm53-flash-exl3-k3.25@tpurtell+v0.9.2; image digest not given in this run's files)
hardware: 2x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition (300 W); GPU only, experts local, no DGX Spark expert nodes

amendments: Amendment 1 (before any result was read): add --hardmode, 88 scenarios instead of 69; re-frozen and restarted

goals.question: With the clear_thinking=false kwarg, do the K4, zai and K4-Core-K6 chat templates render byte-identical text on three tool conversations?
goals.headline: Passed before the freeze: with the kwarg the three templates render byte-identical text on the three conversations; without it, K4 differs on the follow-up case. K4-Core-K6's template checked before the freeze (CORRECTIONS.md).

goals.question: Live, before each arm's repeats: is usage.prompt_tokens equal across all five arms for each gate conversation?

design.instrument: the three gate conversations sent with max_tokens 1 and the kwarg; usage.prompt_tokens

goals.headline: Equal on every arm: tool-loop 192, follow-up 204, two-calls 207 prompt tokens.

goals.question: Run all 88 scenarios of protocol v1 (add --hardmode) after a first start ran 69.
goals.added_source: PROTOCOL.md:44-49 (Amendment 1, before any result was read); times corrected in CORRECTIONS.md
goals.headline: The first start omitted --hardmode (69 scenarios); stopped during the first repeat on V-k325 (about 11:49 per the logs), outputs kept unscored and unpublished; command amended, re-frozen 2026-11-02T11:49:33-08:00, restarted from the first arm.

goals.question: Per arm and repeat, how many of 176 points, and how many pass / partial / fail scenarios, does each engine-checkpoint arm score?
goals.added_source: PROTOCOL.md:17-31 (Block TC; summary per repeat: points of 176, pass/partial/fail)

design.instrument: tool-eval-bench cf54b4b, 88 scenarios incl. 19 Hard Mode (--hardmode), temperature 0, thinking on, 8 parallel, max 8 turns, 900 s timeout, reference date 2026-09-04, clear_thinking=false
design.repeats: seeds 1001, 1002, 1003 on every arm, one server launch per arm
design.interval: none (descriptive; per-repeat range, no significance claim)

goals.headline: Points of 176 per repeat (seeds 1001/1002/1003): V-k325 160, 163, 160; C-k325 163, 163, 163; V-k4 163, 158, 160; C-k4 158, 158, 158; C-k6 160, 160, 160. Harness safety gate not passed on any repeat (TC-43 flagged on every arm). Descriptive, no significance claim.

goals.question: Per checkpoint (K3.25, K4), which scenarios differ between the vLLM fork and CuteAFD in all three repeats?
goals.added_source: PROTOCOL.md:32-33 (reading rule: a scenario differs only if its status differs in all three repeats pairwise)

design.instrument: scenario status sets per arm; differs when the status sets are disjoint (analyze_tc.py)

goals.headline: K3.25: 7 scenarios differ (CuteAFD partial where vLLM passes on TC-23, 31, 40, 50; CuteAFD passes where vLLM is partial on TC-46, 61, 69). K4: 5 differ (TC-53, 62, 67, 68, 76; CuteAFD partial in every repeat). Descriptive.

goals.question: Which scenarios change status between repeats of one arm?
goals.added_source: PROTOCOL.md:15,33 (vLLM repeats known to flip); analyze_tc.py docstring ('counted as unstable')
goals.headline: Status changed between repeats on 8 scenarios for V-k325 and 8 for V-k4; on 0 for every CuteAFD arm (CuteAFD totals identical across the three seeds).

goals.question: On CuteAFD, which scenarios differ between K4-Core-K6 and K4 in all three repeats?
goals.added_source: analyze_tc.py:7-9 (PAIRS includes C-k4 vs C-k6); not in PROTOCOL.md's reading rule, which names engine contrasts; analyze_tc.py is not in FROZEN.json, so when this pair was added is not recorded
goals.headline: 7 scenarios differ: C-k6 passes where C-k4 is partial on TC-53, 62, 68, 76; TC-82 C-k6 partial vs C-k4 pass; TC-85 C-k6 partial vs C-k4 fail; TC-88 C-k6 fail vs C-k4 pass (statuses identical in all three repeats). Descriptive.
goals.status_note: Exploratory: the frozen reading rule (PROTOCOL.md:32-33) names engine contrasts only; analyze_tc.py, which adds this pair, is not among the files hashed in FROZEN.json.

goals.question: Block S: stability over a long serving period.
goals.headline: Not run (decision 2026-11-02: tool calling only); stated as a gap.

goals.question: Accounting: corrections to the frozen protocol text, kept outside PROTOCOL.md so its hash stays valid.
goals.headline: Amendment 1's '11:58' and '10 minutes' corrected from the logs (first repeat started 11:48:19, stopped about 11:49, amended chain frozen 11:49:33); K4-Core-K6's template was checked before the freeze; the run was published as results/2026-11-02-tool-calling (soak not run); Gate R2 as run uses three fixed conversations per arm, not the first request of each scenario.
